whatsNew.summary: Messages answers now read like Meetings. Bold, lists, headings, code and links render as formatted text instead of raw Markdown, in Recent, archived chats and session replies. Copy still copies the original text.

sections.title: Messages, formatted
items: COS answers in Messages show bold, numbered and bulleted lists, headings, quotes and code blocks.
Web links are clickable and open in your browser. Other link types show as plain text, here and in Meetings, Threads and Work.
Row previews show clean text without Markdown symbols.
Search still highlights matches inside formatted answers.
Copy turn and Copy + images still copy the original text.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Italic text now draws as italic in every pane. Before, it showed upright.
